quote: The winner of the 45-month contract, with a score of 99.02 points, is Consorcio A&H La Gina (Acciona Construcción- Acciona Infraestructuras México-Hage Constructora), which submitted an offer of 6.36bn pesos (US$108mn).
note: Opened BNamericas English; DOP 6.36bn / US$108mn dual / Acciona consortium / 45-month confirmed. CapEx-fill enter USD 108m; DOP award retained on Compras Dominicana prior source.
